First Kick Sports
Professor Graham F Welch, Chair of Music Education, UCL Institute of Education, London
Mini First Aid North London
I have been in today to teach first Aid to Key Stage 2. We have been looking at how to assess a casualty and then how to perform certain techniques.
We conducted a series of Climate Ed workshops with the Year 5 classes at St. Agnes, and it was an overall rewarding experience.St. Agnes School values education and also actively invests in providing its students with diverse learning opportunities, evident by the warm welcome given to the Climate Ed Team.
A special thank you to Augustus Martin who recently supported us with creating an advertising leaflet for our school, as well as supplying the paper for the leaflets. Their help and support is much appreciated.
